title: pendingjoin
description: Channel join requests. INSERTED by the folhinhabot.com website; this repo only reads pending rows and updates their status. The fetch task in src/tasks/fetch-pending-joins.js handles each one.

userid.description: Legacy field present on older docs - Twitch user id of the requester

channelid.description: Twitch user id of the channel to join (current field consumed by fetch-pending-joins)

inviterid.description: Twitch user id of whoever invited the bot

created_at.description: When the request was created on the website

status.description: Lifecycle state set by the bot after processing
